title: City launches tree planting campaign
article: The city launched a new tree planting campaign this week to improve air quality and create more shade in busy neighborhoods. Officials said the first phase will focus on school zones, public parks, and major pedestrian routes. Community groups and local businesses have agreed to sponsor volunteers and supplies. Environmental experts believe the effort could lower urban heat and support biodiversity over time. City leaders also said they will publish progress updates every quarter so residents can track the number of trees planted and maintained.

title: New training program helps small businesses adopt AI
article: A regional innovation hub has introduced a training program designed to help small businesses understand practical uses of artificial intelligence. The program includes workshops on automation, customer support tools, forecasting, and responsible data use. Organizers said many small firms are interested in AI but often do not know where to begin or how to evaluate vendors. Early participants reported that the sessions helped them identify realistic pilot projects instead of chasing trends. The hub plans to expand the program next year if demand remains strong.
